entities.summary: Vincent Enrique Hinostroza is an American professional ice hockey player who is a forward for the Florida Panthers of the National Hockey League (NHL). Hinostroza was selected by the Chicago Blackhawks in the sixth round of the 2012 NHL entry draft. He has previously played for the Blackhawks, Arizona Coyotes, Buffalo Sabres, Pittsburgh Penguins, Nashville Predators, and Minnesota Wild.
